reason: Repository evidence shows this plugin is a UI navigation enhancement for DSH Web GUI conversations: it generates a minimap from user prompts, tracks position during conversation scrolling, and enables hover and click navigation, with no evidence of unrelated features like build tooling, automation workflows, code generation, or external service integrations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web GUI 的会话导航插件，在对话区域显示基于用户提示词的迷你地图，并支持悬停预览与点击跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web GUI conversation navigation plugin that displays a prompt-based minimap in the chat view, with hover previews and click-to-jump behavior for messages.

capabilities: Renders a user-facing vertical minimap rail of conversation prompts inside the DSH Web GUI.
Reads conversation context/history via DSH session APIs to build and sync navigation anchors.
Provides hover previews and click-to-scroll navigation behavior within the conversation view.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a prompt-based conversation minimap shown as a vertical rail with hover previews and click jumps.
How-it-works section says it pulls conversation data through ctx.sessions and conversation.loadOlder and observes rendered message DOM.
Package metadata marks it as a web client plugin with Cordis patch entry and plugin entry points.
